component.name: Resizable
component.description: Resizable panel layout with draggable dividers and keyboard support.

slots.name: root
slots.description: Layout container that owns resizable panels and handles.

dataAttributes.name: data-resizable-root
dataAttributes.description: Identifies the root container of a resizable layout.

slots.name: panel
slots.description: Content pane whose size is controlled by adjacent resize handles.

dataAttributes.name: data-collapsed
dataAttributes.description: Present when the panel or section is collapsed.

dataAttributes.name: data-expanded
dataAttributes.description: Present when the panel, accordion, or menu is expanded.

dataAttributes.name: data-resizing
dataAttributes.description: Present while resizable handles are actively dragging.

dataAttributes.name: data-transitioning
dataAttributes.description: State or slot attribute exposed for styling hooks and selectors.

dataAttributes.name: data-active
dataAttributes.description: Present when the item or trigger is active.

dataAttributes.name: data-cross
dataAttributes.description: State or slot attribute exposed for styling hooks and selectors.

dataAttributes.name: data-dragging
dataAttributes.description: Present while the related thumb or handle is being dragged.

ariaAttributes.name: aria-controls
ariaAttributes.description: References the controlled element while the related content is mounted.

ariaAttributes.name: aria-disabled
ariaAttributes.description: Indicates that the control is disabled.

ariaAttributes.name: aria-valuemax
ariaAttributes.description: Defines the maximum value for range-like controls.

ariaAttributes.name: aria-valuemin
ariaAttributes.description: Defines the minimum value for range-like controls.

ariaAttributes.name: aria-valuenow
ariaAttributes.description: Defines the current numeric value for range-like controls.

ariaAttributes.name: role
ariaAttributes.description: Defines the semantic role exposed to assistive technology.

slots.name: handle
slots.description: Interactive target users drag or focus to resize panels.

dataAttributes.name: data-collapse
dataAttributes.description: State or slot attribute exposed for styling hooks and selectors.

slots.name: crossTarget
slots.description: Extra hit target used when nested handles meet across axes.

dataAttributes.description: State or slot attribute exposed for styling hooks and selectors.

dataAttributes.name: data-resizable-handle-start-target
dataAttributes.description: State or slot attribute exposed for styling hooks and selectors.

own.name: children
own.description: Content rendered inside the panel.

own.name: class
own.description: Class applied to the component root or trigger element.

own.name: collapsible
own.description:
Whether the panel is collapsible.
This prop is reactive; toggling `true/false` can be used as a simple collapse signal.

own.name: collapsibleMin
own.description:
Size of the panel when collapsed.
Only works when `collapsible` is true.
- Use string as percent, like `20%`
- Use number as px, like `328`

own.name: defaultSize
own.description:
Default size of the panel (uncontrolled).
- Use string as percent, like `20%`
- Use number as px, like `328`

own.name: max
own.description:
Maximum size of the panel.
- Use string as percent, like `20%`
- Use number as px, like `328`

own.name: min
own.description:
Minimum size of the panel.
- Use string as percent, like `20%`
- Use number as px, like `328`

own.name: onCollapse
own.description: Callback when the panel is collapsed.

own.name: onExpand
own.description: Callback when the panel is expanded.

own.name: onResize
own.description: Callback when the panel is resized.

own.type: JSX.HTMLElementTags["div"] extends { ref?: infer Ref; } ? Ref : never | undefined

own.name: resizable
own.description: Whether the panel is resizable.

own.name: size
own.description:
Current size of the panel (controlled).
- Use string as percent, like `20%`
- Use number as px, like `328`

own.name: action
